title: Mini Clean Volume - Volumizing Tubing Mascara
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Volumizing✓ Long-wearing✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A buildable tubing mascara that lifts, separates, and sculpts lashes for precise, all-day volume.

Formulation Type: Volumizing and Lengthening

Benefits: Long-wearing

What Else You Need to Know: Finally, a volumizing mascara that actually lifts. Designed with a petite precision brush, it works with MERIT’s lightweight, Japanese-made tubing formula to build clump-free volume, length, and lift that’s precise—never heavy or overdone. Safe for sensitive eyes; removes with warm water.

Clean at Sephora
Clean at Sephora is our commitment to offering effective products without certain ingredients, such as parabens, sulfates, phthalates, and mineral oils.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Comb through lashes from root to tip. Build up for more impact.
-To remove, wash with warm water and cleanser.
Ingredients+
Water (Aqua/Eau), Ammonium Styrene/Acrylates Copolymer, Butylene Glycol, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax (Copernicia Cerifera Cera/Cire De Carnauba), Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Stearic Acid, Glyceryl Stearate, Pentylene Glycol, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Cetearyl Alcohol, PVP, Aminomethyl Propanol, Glycerin, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Wax, Acrylates/Va Copolymer, Xanthan Gum, Polyglyceryl-10 Myristate, Alcohol, Myrothamnus Flabellifolia Leaf/Stem Extract, Isochrysis Galbana Extract; May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): CI 77491/CI 77492/CI 77499 (Iron Oxides).

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
